page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with 1 thread per core under a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU alongside a balanced CPU-to-memory ratio, this instance is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require massive parallel compute or high local storage IOPS. It represents an entry-level GPU hardware profile, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads such as small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic graphics rendering where high-end accelerators are not economically justified.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance from the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. This instance does not feature local storage, relying instead on network-attached volumes, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Qualitatively, the hardware configuration offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU-driven tasks. It is suited for workloads such as low-latency machine learning inference, media transcoding, and lightweight parallel processing tasks that benefit from dedicated GPU acceleration without requiring high-end enterprise accelerators.
